A '''[[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]]''' served as a gunnery officer aboard [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] flagship, [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']]. He was present on the ship during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. The Neimoidian was promoted to senior gunnery officer after the [[Unidentified senior gunnery officer 1 (Invisible Hand)|previous officer]] was killed by Grievous for failing to obey orders in time. However, he didn't have long to enjoy his new position, as he was killed shortly after when his console exploded.
